6FYZFAuhFV4.description:
Well this is the best way to not forget to tighten the gas pipe up on your new jet engine.AS A NOTE THIS HAPPENED BEFORE LAST VIDEO SO I'M FINE. Just before my first test fire i,d been messing with the oil pipes and had loosened the gas pipe so could move engine around easier then forgot and during to test fire BOOM ,Ne Mind.

Check my other pages for news and pictures 
Twitter https://twitter.com/colin_furze
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/realcolinfurze/
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Colin-furze-521680751253584
http://www.colinfurze.com

Here are some answers to possible questions

1- This was no fault of the no weld jet engine
2- Why didn't i smell it, well these things do stink a bit on start up so kinda overlooked it
3- I didn,t move straight away as you often get flames pop out back.
4- its not 3rd degree its just a badish burn i think
5- Good news as once healed tightened pipe up and jet works a treat
6- My tip if you get burnt is wrap arm in cling film this helped loads
7- What have i learnt, nothing as i knew loose gas pipes can leak before all this i just forgot i'd loosened it
8- You wont achive anything in life if you don't try things, just sometimes you get burnt

To see pictures of my arms go to http://www.colinfurze.com/mr-burns.html
